criteria.id: upper layers use one internal huntianling.database service and do not import a concrete driver
schema migrations are recorded with a version
existing JSON board data is imported into database tables
after import, board reads and writes use the database as the source of truth
large file content is stored outside the database
the database stores upload filename, MIME type, size, sha256, uploader, project, storage path, extracted-text status, and references
uploads are stored under a configurable workspace storage root
files that exceed configured size or type limits are rejected
the file storage interface can be replaced without requiring MinIO
